findings.violated_requirement: The frozen review package must preserve relevant decision supersession evidence. Superseding a decision changes the prior record to SUPERSEDED, while build_package includes only currently CONFIRMED decisions and excludes the decision event history. A reviewer limited to the package cannot compare a new decision with the prior confirmed decision when assessing an unsupported reversal.

BLOCKED must indicate that external input prevents further progress. evaluate_completion returns BLOCKED whenever all live blockers are external, even if independent authorized work items are READY or ACTIVE. The Stop hook then declines continuation despite an available next action.

unresolved_unknowns: The package does not show an end-to-end test of supersession review visibility or of a task with both an external blocker and independent ready work.
